issues.concern: The translation for example 2 incorrectly translates '糖質と糖類' as 'sugars and sugar content'. '糖質' (tōshitsu) refers to carbohydrates in general (excluding dietary fiber), while '糖類' (tōrui) specifically refers to sugars (mono- and disaccharides). The English translation should reflect this distinction.
issues.suggestion: Looking at the nutrition label, carbohydrates and sugars are listed separately under the carbohydrate breakdown.
